name: fall-rush
description: Fall Rush — 12-player knockout party game on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups (Blitz V10)

scripts.m1:build:server: bash scripts/m1-unity.sh server -buildTarget Linux64 -standaloneBuildSubtarget Server -executeMethod Build.Server
scripts.m1:up: bash scripts/m1-certs.sh && chmod -R a+rX client-unity/Builds/WebGL && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.m1.yml up -d --build
scripts.m1:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.m1.yml down; bash scripts/m1-macserver.sh stop
scripts.m1:up:mac: bash scripts/m1-certs.sh && chmod -R a+rX client-unity/Builds/WebGL && bash scripts/m1-macserver.sh start && GAMESERVER_UPSTREAM=host.docker.internal:7777 docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.m1.yml up -d --no-deps nginx
